docs.title: 眨眼呼叫 用户手册
docs.text: 眨眼呼叫 是一个为 ALS（肌萎缩侧索硬化，俗称渐冻症）患者设计的辅助呼叫系统。它可以从摄像头输入中识别用户自定义的眨眼模式，并触发电脑扬声器（或者蓝牙设备）响铃提醒，期间无需说话、手部动作或物理接触。

docs.title: 核心特性
docs.text:
• 无需言语行动：仅需通过眨眼模式即可操作，无需说话、手部动作或物理接触。
  • 轻量资源占用：可在纯 CPU 环境运行，内存占用低于 500 MB。
  • 用户友好：
    • 支持自定义眨眼模式、提醒音频、音量与持续时间。
    • 同时支持本地摄像头与远程摄像头模式，部署更灵活。
    • 支持一键下载与更新模型文件。
    • 提供日志与调试选项，便于现场使用和算法改进。

docs.title: 下载软件
docs.text:
以下三个途径任选其一即可：

  • 百度网盘
  • 夸克网盘
  • GitHub

下载最新版本的软件压缩包，并解压至任意目录后，双击打开文件夹内名为BlinkCall.exe的软件即可。

docs.title: 费用
docs.text: 完全公益免费！

docs.title: 首次使用
docs.text:
1. 点击左上角【设置】按钮打开设置窗口。
  2. 在【眨眼呼叫】-【下载/更新模型文件】处，点击【下载/更新】按钮，等待模型文件下载完毕。

docs.title: 开始呼叫
docs.text:
1. 保持面部在画面中，面部区域大小适中。最重要的是要能清晰看清双眼的睁闭状态。
  2. 按已设置的眨眼序列执行动作。可使用上方进度条辅助观察：
    • 浅绿色代表睁眼
    • 浅黄色代表闭眼
    • 深绿色代表当前眨眼进度
  3. 重要：在眨眼序列中，请保持睁/闭眼直至当前阶段完成。在完成后的 3 秒内开始做下一阶段的睁/闭动作，否则眨眼进度会清零。
  4. 触发后进入呼叫提醒状态，电脑会在设定的时间内播放声音提醒。如需提前关闭，请点击软件下方的关闭按钮。

docs.title: 【常规】-【语言】
docs.text: 可切换中英文显示。

docs.title: 【常规】-【亮暗模式】
docs.text: 可切换浅色或深色外观。此设置只影响显示效果，不影响软件功能。

docs.title: 【摄像头】-【选择视频来源】
docs.text:
• 本地摄像头：使用当前电脑的内置或外接摄像头。
  • 远程摄像头：使用局域网内其他电脑的内置或外接摄像头。

docs.title: 【摄像头】-【启动本地摄像头服务】
docs.text: 将当前电脑的内置或外接摄像头提供给局域网内的其他电脑使用。

docs.title: 【眨眼呼叫】-【开启眨眼呼叫】
docs.text: 选择是否启用眨眼呼叫功能。

docs.title: 【眨眼呼叫】-【显示首页上方进度条】
docs.text: 选择显示或隐藏首页上方的眨眼呼叫进度条。

docs.title: 【眨眼呼叫】-【眨眼序列】
docs.text:
自定义眨眼动作序列，要求如下：

  • 最少 1 项，最多可根据需要增加。
  • 每项可选择睁眼或闭眼其中之一。
  • 每项时长范围为 0.5 秒至 5 秒。
  • 默认配置：睁眼 2 秒 → 闭眼 2 秒 → 睁眼 2 秒 → 闭眼 2 秒。

docs.title: 【眨眼呼叫】-【播放呼叫音频】
docs.text: 选择触发呼叫时是否发出铃声。

docs.title: 【眨眼呼叫】-【呼叫音频文件】
docs.text: 选择不同的呼叫铃声。

docs.title: 【眨眼呼叫】-【音频音量】
docs.text: 选择音频播放音量。注意：此设置为软件的音量控制，不会影响电脑系统音量设置。

docs.title: 【眨眼呼叫】-【音频播放时长】
docs.text:
选择呼叫触发时音频的播放持续时长：

  • 最低设置为 10 秒。
  • 最长可设置为无限长。

docs.title: 【眨眼呼叫】-【下载/更新模型文件】
docs.text: 下载或更新软件所需的机器学习模型文件。

docs.title: 【其他】-【录制当前相机数据】
docs.text:
启动录制当前软件画面中的视频数据，并保存在指定位置（默认为桌面）。配置说明：

  • 最短录制时长：1 分钟。
  • 最长录制时长：1440 分钟（24 小时）。

docs.title: 【其他】-【调试模式】
docs.text: 选择是否启用调试模式，以及是否将日志文件保存到本地。

docs.title: 【其他】-【恢复默认设置】
docs.text: 将所有设置项恢复至默认值。

docs.title: Blink Call User Manual
docs.text: Blink Call is an auxiliary call system designed for ALS (Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis, also known as Lou Gehrig's disease) patients. It recognizes user-defined blink patterns from camera input and triggers an alert sound through computer speakers or Bluetooth devices, requiring no speech, hand gestures, or physical contact.

docs.title: Core Features
docs.text:
• Hands-Free Operation: Operate using only blink patterns, no speech, hand gestures, or physical contact required.
  • Lightweight Resource Usage: Runs in pure CPU environments with memory consumption below 500 MB.
  • User-Friendly:
    • Support for customizable blink patterns, alert audio, volume, and duration.
    • Flexible deployment with both local and remote camera modes.
    • One-click model file download and update.
    • Logging and debugging options for monitoring usage and algorithm improvement.

docs.title: Download Software
docs.text:
Choose any one of the following options to download:

  • Baidu Netdisk
  • Quark Netdisk
  • GitHub

Download the latest version of the software package, extract it to any directory, and double-click the BlinkCall.exe file in the folder to launch the application.

docs.title: Free to Use
docs.text: Completely free and non-profit!

docs.title: First Time Setup
docs.text:
1. Click the [Settings] button in the top-left corner to open the settings window.
  2. Navigate to [Blink Call]-[Download/Update Model Files], and click the [Download/Update] button. Wait for the model files to complete downloading.

docs.title: Start Making a Call
docs.text:
1. Keep your face centered in the video frame with an appropriate face size. The most important thing is to clearly show your eye opening and closing state.
  2. Perform the configured blink sequence according to the preset pattern. You can use the progress bar at the top to observe:
    • Light green represents eyes open
    • Light yellow represents eyes closed
    • Dark green represents current blink progress
  3. Important: Keep your eyes in the open/closed state until the current stage is complete. Within 3 seconds after completing a stage, start the next stage's eye movement. If you exceed this time, the blink progress will reset.
  4. After triggering, the system enters call alert mode, and your computer will play an alert sound for the configured duration. To stop it early, click the close button at the bottom of the window.

docs.title: [General]-[Language]
docs.text: Switch between Chinese and English display language.

docs.title: [General]-[Light/Dark Mode]
docs.text: Switch between light or dark appearance. This setting only affects the display theme and does not impact software functionality.

docs.title: [Camera]-[Select Video Source]
docs.text:
• Local Camera: Use the built-in or external camera on the current computer.
  • Remote Camera: Use the built-in or external camera of another computer on the local network.

docs.title: [Camera]-[Start Local Camera Service]
docs.text: Share the current computer's built-in or external camera with other computers on the local network.

docs.title: [Blink Call]-[Enable Blink Call]
docs.text: Choose whether to enable the blink call functionality.

docs.title: [Blink Call]-[Show Progress Bar on Home Screen]
docs.text: Choose to show or hide the blink call progress bar at the top of the home screen.

docs.title: [Blink Call]-[Blink Sequence]
docs.text:
Customize the blink action sequence with the following requirements:

  • Minimum of 1 item, can add more as needed.
  • Each item can be either eyes open or eyes closed.
  • Duration for each item ranges from 0.5 seconds to 5 seconds.
  • Default configuration: Eyes open 2 sec → Eyes closed 2 sec → Eyes open 2 sec → Eyes closed 2 sec.

docs.title: [Blink Call]-[Play Call Audio]
docs.text: Choose whether to play an alert sound when a call is triggered.

docs.title: [Blink Call]-[Call Audio File]
docs.text: Select different alert ringtones.

docs.title: [Blink Call]-[Audio Volume]
docs.text: Adjust the audio playback volume. Note: This is the software's volume control and will not affect your system volume settings.

docs.title: [Blink Call]-[Audio Play Duration]
docs.text:
Set the duration for audio playback when a call is triggered:

  • Minimum duration: 10 seconds.
  • Maximum duration: Unlimited.

docs.title: [Blink Call]-[Download/Update Model Files]
docs.text: Download or update the machine learning model files required by the software.

docs.title: [Other]-[Record Current Camera Data]
docs.text:
Start recording the video data displayed in the software and save it to a specified location (default is Desktop). Configuration details:

  • Minimum recording duration: 1 minute.
  • Maximum recording duration: 1440 minutes (24 hours).

docs.title: [Other]-[Debug Mode]
docs.text: Choose whether to enable debug mode and whether to save log files locally.

docs.title: [Other]-[Restore Default Settings]
docs.text: Restore all settings to their default values.
